entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like the humps of a gigantic dinosaur

entries.en: Hunched shoulders of the craggy mountain

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.en: Framed by the mountain’s majestic peaks

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Split, cracked and carved by the magic of nature
entries.zh: 被大自然的魔力所分裂、分裂和雕刻

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Crushed them in its stony mouth
entries.zh: 粉碎了它们在它的臭嘴里

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shattered by nature into jagged blades
entries.zh: 被自然切成条纹的刀片

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 笼罩在浓厚的风暴云中

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hostile peaks jumped out of the mist
entries.zh: 敌对的山峰从雾中跳出

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gloomy, brooding summit lay in wait
entries.zh: 郁闷,隆隆的峰顶在等待

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Edged their way to the top

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Scrambled up the sheer, rugged slopes

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Tore their hands and knees on the jagged rocks
entries.zh: 把他们的手和膝盖 绑在岩石上

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Towering, snow-capped mountains rose to meet the sky.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was surrounded by the soaring summits of the majestic mountains.
entries.zh: 他被猛烈的山峰所包围

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A magical world of shimmering snow towered above the wooden chalets of the mountain village.
entries.zh: 山村木盘上方 闪闪发光的雪花世界

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: From high up on the summit of the mountain, they had a spectacular view of green meadows and streams like silver ribbons.
entries.zh: 从山顶高处开始,他们拥有一幅壮观的绿草地和银丝带等溪流的景象.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Split, cracked and carved by the magic of nature, the rocks had created a path of shimmering pillars and arches.
entries.zh: 岩石造就了一条闪烁的柱子和拱门

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The huge, hostile mountain pierced the sky.
entries.zh: 巨大的敌对的山穿透了天空.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Mountains, like gigantic spearheads, towered above her.
entries.zh: 山,像巨大的先锋, 塔在她上面。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The top of the mountain was covered by a ghostly blanket of dark clouds.
entries.zh: 山顶被鬼毯遮蔽着暗云.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The steep slopes rose towards the shark-finned ridges of the huge mountain.
entries.zh: 陡峭的山坡向着巨大山脊的鲨鱼鳍隆起.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The snow-capped summit of the mountain soared above her and to reach it she knew she would have to climb the sheer, deadly slopes.
entries.zh: 山顶的雪盖在她上方飞升 为了到达它 她知道她必须爬上 致命的山坡

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Enormous boulders of jagged rock blocked the path and he had to wind his way over and through the inky black maze.
entries.zh: 巨大的巨石堵住了道路 他不得不绕过和穿过黑黑迷宫

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Like huge black daggers, the savage summits burst out of the trees.
entries.zh: 就像巨大的黑色匕首一样 野蛮的山峰从树上冲出来

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The mountains loomed ahead like a giant black shadow, their peaks like huge, pointed black teeth waiting to crush him in their stony mouth.
entries.zh: 山脉像巨大的黑影一样笼罩在前方,它们的峰像巨大的,尖尖的黑牙等待着将他压碎在他们的石质嘴里.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The steep path glistened with damp – polished by nature into dangerous, slippery slopes.
entries.zh: 陡峭的道路被潮湿闪烁 — — 被自然磨成危险的滑坡。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was faced by a haunting maze of ice and rock, glimmering white, stark and hostile.
entries.zh: 他面对着冰和岩石的迷宫,闪闪发光的白色,严酷和敌对.
